a, b, limit = map(int, input().split())

MAX_INF = 99999999
smallest_diff = MAX_INF
num, den = 0, 0

for i in range(1, limit + 1):
    candidate = int(round(1.0 * a * i / b - 0.0000001))
    diff = abs((1.0 * a / b) - (1.0 * candidate / i))
    if diff < smallest_diff:
        num = candidate
        den = i
        smallest_diff = diff

print(f"{num}/{den}")
